Research · #26 · 27 September 2026

The page stays a page.

The selected combined treatment alongside the original background studies, using the accepted Folio symbols. Compare color hierarchy and small-size clarity, then validate the chosen direction through macOS composition.

Illustrative mockups, not Finder captures. Page proportions, fold, label and badge placement are approximations, adjusted after a native macOS rendering probe. The square background is clipped to a narrower page, not stretched to fill it. Badge artwork is the existing size-specific asset; backgrounds are new vector studies. The combined treatment uses a constant hue with varying alpha, with no white fill in its background layer; the paper and fold shown here are separate simulated system layers. Dark surroundings change the viewing surface, not the icon palette. Small list samples intentionally omit text, and use the accepted tiny badge versions. The selected D uses the actual generated background assets: its larger zipper lives in the upper-left, inset from the bar at 128 points and above. Documents and archives share the same tightly fitted symbol badge. Earlier A/B/C concepts omit the new background zipper.
